entries.zh: 山中；山里（西语又指山间沟壑）
entries.en: in the mountains; a ravine of the mountain
the bottom of the sea; seabed
entries.notes: L 栏讹写（z Baja aelmar 当为 baja del mar），释义据 H 栏「海底」与 M 栏 hay-ti 坐实。

entries.en: brittle; that breaks easily (quebradizo)
entries.notes: H 栏「含梢」非通行词形、M 栏 ham-sau 与「脆」义不合，仅据西语 quebradico（=quebradizo）推定。

entries.en: a break, fracture; crack (melladura)
entries.notes: H 栏仅存「珀/珆」疑难字形，M 栏 it-la-tiam 未能坐实，释义依西语 quebradura o melladura 推定。

entries.en: 〔source columns empty; meaning uncertain〕
entries.notes: 仅西语词头 Quebrado, y. petra~ 存留，汉字栏与两音写栏皆空。

entries.en: to violate the law
entries.notes: H 栏第二字残损；M 栏连排 oy/hoan/con ey/hoan lue 多组读音，似并录「故违」「犯律」诸条。

entries.en: to break up the demons' array; conjure/expel the demons
entries.notes: L 栏讹乱，仅 los demonios 可辨（conguar 当为 conjurar），释义据 H 栏「破陣」与 M 栏 poa-tin。

entries.en: to offend deliberately; break the law willfully
to break the law knowingly and deliberately

entries.zh: 犯法无主；违法而无所约束
entries.en: to break the law without restraint; an offense with none to answer for it
entries.notes: L 栏 timcui dar 讹乱；「無主」究竟指无主裁抑或无所忌惮存疑。

entries.en: to violate a prohibition; do what is forbidden
to break the law; offend against the law

entries.zh: 故违；明知故违（故意违犯）
entries.en: to violate deliberately; willful transgression
to break the statute; transgress the legal code

entries.zh: 破戒；犯戒（毁弃誓愿戒约）
entries.en: to break one's (religious) vows or precepts

entries.zh: 风气；风邪之气（受风所伤而动转不得）
entries.en: stricken by wind(-qi) so as to be unable to move; wind ailment

entries.zh: 风气痛（风气致病之痛；风湿作痛）
entries.en: wind-qi pain; aching caused by pathogenic wind (rheumatic)
to break; a broken thing (cosa quebrada)
entries.notes: R 栏残损；M 栏并列 ping/huay/poa/po 数读，均归「破」义。

entries.en: to break (as a rope); to sever (a friendship)
to come apart; scatter, disperse
entries.notes: M 栏音写 ey/pey 与「散」对音不合，字义依 H 栏与西语 quebrar，音写归属待复核。
